citation.note: Seven-day written notice before wage change (§ 41-10-30): Any increase or decrease in base wage, bonus structure, or commission rate requires seven calendar days' written advance notice before effective date.

Personnel file documentation (§ 41-10-30(C), three-year retention): Record promotion decision, wage change, effective date, business rationale, and seven-day notice delivery in personnel file; retain for three years.
Final pay timing: § 41-10-50 requires payment of all wages within 48 hours of separation or next regular payday (not exceeding 30 days).
